If smoking on planes is banned… why does the bathroom have an ashtray?
It's not a mistake. It's required.
Aviation safety rules require an ashtray on the lavatory door.
Why? Because someone always smokes in secret.
And without an ashtray, where do they put it out?
In the bathroom trash. Full of paper.
In 1973, a Brazilian plane flying from Rio to Paris caught fire right in the bathroom.
The main suspect: a cigarette thrown in the trash.
More than a hundred people died.
That's why the ashtray is still there.
No one should use it… but if someone does, it can save the plane.
